authority.policy: Only assets listed in this registry may be used by CYQ-GAME. Discovery of a new or changed asset does not authorize use: register it first, freeze its lineage, validate the registry, and pass every activation gate.

pit_grade_definitions.A: Strict archival PIT: immutable original or vintage, actual available_at, source, snapshot_id, content hash, and revision chain are preserved.
pit_grade_definitions.B: Frozen causal research: event or disclosure timing is causal and a frozen capture exists, but supplier revision history or record-level lineage is incomplete.
pit_grade_definitions.C: Current historical snapshot: may be used only for discovery or reconciliation; it cannot prove what was knowable at a past decision time.
pit_grade_definitions.D: Unavailable or intrinsically unobservable with the approved data sources.

status_definitions.RESEARCH_CONDITIONAL: Materialized data that may become a research input only after its listed activation gates pass. Registration alone is not activation.
status_definitions.DERIVE_ONLY: A deterministic transform that must be regenerated exclusively from activated registered inputs.
status_definitions.QA_ONLY: May be used for adapter, schema, reconciliation, or cross-source checks; never for states, signals, sizing, or performance claims.
status_definitions.DISCOVERY_ONLY: A source or snapshot known to exist but not yet materialized and validated as a causal research input.
status_definitions.DEMO_ONLY: Synthetic or demonstration data for software tests only.
status_definitions.GENERATED_OUTPUT: Mutable state or run output; it is never an authoritative source fact.
status_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: Not available or not observable; dependent design claims are prohibited.

global_gate.reason: CY-006 and CY-008 are the frozen v2 daily and minute PIT-B research tables. change_log.change: Initial CY project data baseline. Registered physical quant assets, candidate free sources, CY fixtures, unavailable inputs, usage boundaries, PIT grades, and activation gates. Explicitly retained pre-2020 local minute data as conditional research input.

Corrected QD-004 lineage semantics: its existing manifest freezes source lineage and aggregate quality evidence but does not hash every output Parquet. Marked immutable_manifest=false and added an exact per-file content inventory as an activation gate.

Frozen exact content inventories for QD-001 eligible raw daily bars, QD-002 trading states, QD-003 index bars, and QD-004 target 2018-2026 minute partitions. This completes file-level freezing only; record-level PIT fields and activation gates remain incomplete.

Registered and froze the existing quant Eastmoney disclosure-chronology industry history as QD-008. The daily table enforces notice_date < trade_date; UNKNOWN rows fail closed. This is causal research grade B, not strict archival PIT A.

Registered and froze QMT Capital history as QD-009. The adapter requires both effective and announcement dates to be known, selects the latest causal revision, and fails closed on nonpositive circulating shares.

Registered CY-003, the frozen 9,421,907-row daily PIT-B table. Exact nine-file inventory is frozen; coverage, duplicate, time-travel, consistency, and cross-table audits all PASS; 356,129 hard-invalid rows remain explicit and fail closed. Enabled causal daily research and backtest authorization only for an exact input-snapshot manifest. Strict PIT-A remains false.

Registered CY-004 as a targeted immutable PIT-B repair snapshot for 000820.SZ. Its 2,088 overlapping OHLC rows match CY-003, turnover differs by at most 0.000104 percentage points, and official evidence identifies 15 bad legacy state rows. Activation is limited to causal chip replay through 2026-08-20 with exact hashes and mass-conservation gates.

Registered CY-005 as a targeted immutable PIT-B research bundle for 301511.SZ through the 2026-08-20 close. The exact BaoStock snapshot, nine official disclosures, corporate-action references, 2026-08-17 float change, and cross-source audit pass. Activation is limited to conditional single-stock research; full-market, sector leave-one-out, current rule, calibrated EdgeCard, and execution claims remain blocked.

Registered CY-006 daily PIT-B v2 and CY-008 minute PIT-B v2. Frozen 9 daily and 27 minute feature/execution files; all daily gates, nine annual minute audits, and the minute cross-year gate pass. Runtime activation must bind both exact inventories and keep same-bar fills prohibited.

Registered CY-009, the immutable 9,421,907-row frozen chip-state feature table in annual date-sorted layout. Feature and content-equivalence gates pass. Runtime may reuse these causal pre-trade states instead of recomputing them from minute arrays; four representative daily queries improved by 26.76x.
